### Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template: `DATA_ROOT` is the results directory given to `depictio ingest`, the others are set with `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory of one DROP run (the outdir: processed_results/, pipeline_info/ ...) |
| `SAMPLESHEET` | — | The sample sheet the run was given as --input (TSV with RNA_ID, DROP_GROUP and the optional columns). Relative to DATA_ROOT, or an absolute path or URL. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Sample-hub column the group filter, cards and colouring read: the sample's most specific DROP_GROUP. |
| `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY` | — | Title-cased GROUP_COL for display. |
| `GENOME` | — | UCSC assembly name the genome browser opens on (the genome the alignments were made against). |
| `TRACKS_URI` | — | s3:// or https:// folder to read relative track paths of the sample sheet under, in place, instead of uploading them from DATA_ROOT. Paths that are already URLs are always read in place. |
| `AE_PADJ` | — | Adjusted p-value at or below which an OUTRIDER gene is called an outlier. |
| `AE_MIN_Z` | — | Absolute z-score at or above which an OUTRIDER gene is called an outlier (0 keeps every gene the run reported). |
| `AS_PADJ` | — | Gene-level adjusted p-value at or below which a FRASER gene is called an outlier. |
| `AS_MIN_DPSI` | — | Absolute change in splicing usage (delta PSI, 0 to 1) at or above which a FRASER junction is called. |
| `NOMINAL_P` | — | Raw (uncorrected) p-value at or below which an OUTRIDER gene or FRASER junction is shown as a nominal hit. A run too small to pass the adjusted cut-offs calls nothing; the nominal hits are then the leads, to be read with care. |
| `BACKGROUND_ROWS` | — | Rows per sample the expression and splicing tables keep besides the called ones and those with an adjusted p-value of 0.5 or less, taken from the most significant by raw p-value. They are the background of the volcano. A negative value keeps every row. |
| `CANDIDATES_PER_SAMPLE` | — | Best-supported genes per sample kept in the triage list besides the genes an analysis calls. |
| `MAE_PADJ` | — | Adjusted p-value at or below which a heterozygous variant is called mono-allelic. |
| `MAE_MIN_RATIO` | — | Share of the reads (0.5 to 1) the dominant allele needs for a mono-allelic call. |

### Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `OUTPUT_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`nf-core/drop/expression_outliers.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/drop/recipes/expression_outliers.py) | Aberrant expression calls of nf-core/drop: OUTRIDER outliers, one row per sample and gene. | `call_id`, `sample`, `gene_id`, `gene_name`, `annotation`, `drop_group`, `status`, `p_value`, `padj`, `z_score`, `abs_z_score`, `l2fc`, `neg_log10_p`, `neg_log10_padj`, `avg_log_count`, `raw_count`, `expected_count`, `mean_count`, `significant`, `nominal`, `direction`, `hpo_match`, `chrom`, `start`, `end` |
| [`nf-core/drop/gene_evidence.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/drop/recipes/gene_evidence.py) | The genes with the strongest evidence over the cohort, one row per gene and one column per analysis. | `gene_name`, `Expression`, `Splicing`, `Mono-allelic`, `best_support`, `samples_called`, `samples_listed`, `evidence`, `phenotype_gene` |
| [`nf-core/drop/group_membership.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/drop/recipes/group_membership.py) | nf-core/drop analysis groups, one row per sample and group it belongs to. | `sample`, `drop_group`, `count_source`, `has_dna` |
| [`nf-core/drop/mae_variants.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/drop/recipes/mae_variants.py) | Mono-allelic expression calls of nf-core/drop: heterozygous SNVs, one row per sample and variant. | `call_id`, `sample`, `gene_name`, `drop_group`, `annotation`, `chrom`, `start`, `end`, `locus`, `variant_id`, `ref_allele`, `alt_allele`, `ref_count`, `alt_count`, `total_count`, `alt_ratio`, `p_value`, `padj`, `neg_log10_padj`, `avg_log_count`, `log2fc`, `mono_allelic`, `call`, `rare` |
| [`nf-core/drop/outlier_genes.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/drop/recipes/outlier_genes.py) | One row per sample and gene across the three DROP analyses: the triage list. | `call_id`, `sample`, `drop_group`, `gene_name`, `expression_outlier`, `splicing_outlier`, `mae_outlier`, `n_analyses`, `n_nominal`, `support`, `called_in`, `phenotype_gene`, `phenotype`, `significance`, `sample_rank`, `expression_score`, `splicing_score`, `mae_score`, `z_score`, `l2fc`, `expression_padj`, `delta_psi`, `splicing_padj`, `alt_ratio`, `mae_padj`, `chrom`, `start`, `end`, `locus` |
| [`nf-core/drop/sample_outliers.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/drop/recipes/sample_outliers.py) | Outliers per sample across the three DROP analyses: the sample-level quality read. | `sample`, `drop_group`, `count_source`, `expression_outliers`, `over_expressed`, `under_expressed`, `splicing_outliers`, `mae_calls`, `mae_variants_tested`, `total_outliers`, `expression_nominal`, `splicing_nominal`, `nominal_hits`, `phenotype_matches`, `has_outlier` |
| [`nf-core/drop/samples.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/drop/recipes/samples.py) | The nf-core/drop sample hub: one row per RNA sample of the run's sample sheet. | `sample`, `drop_group`, `drop_groups`, `n_groups`, `group_size`, `count_source`, `strandedness`, `read_type`, `count_mode`, `has_dna`, `n_hpo_terms`, `annotation`, `genome` |
| [`nf-core/drop/splicing_outliers.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/drop/recipes/splicing_outliers.py) | Aberrant splicing calls of nf-core/drop: FRASER outliers, one row per sample and gene. | `call_id`, `sample`, `gene_name`, `annotation`, `drop_group`, `status`, `p_value`, `padj_gene`, `delta_psi`, `chrom`, `start`, `end`, `locus`, `strand`, `psi_type`, `psi_value`, `abs_delta_psi`, `padj`, `neg_log10_p`, `neg_log10_padj`, `avg_log_reads`, `split_reads`, `total_reads`, `significant`, `nominal`, `direction`, `hpo_match` |
| [`nf-core/drop/tracks.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/drop/recipes/tracks.py) | Genome-browser track manifest: the alignments and genotypes the sample sheet points at. | `track_id`, `sample`, `drop_group`, `kind`, `format`, `uri`, `index_uri`, `name`, `category`, `order` |
